purpose: Improve same full-candidate query-ranking task; preserve first experiment unchanged
validation: Same 6000 sampled validation queries as v1; full original candidate lists
confirmation_exclusion: Exclude every supplied sessionId appearing anywhere in the original test sample before sampling; no confirmation target analysis before selection freeze
history: Same provided sessionId and date, strictly prior timestamped query clicks, most recent 10 distinct products
statistics: For train queries source dates <= query date minus 2 days; validation statistics capped at 2016-04-29; confirmation statistics capped at 2016-05-14
recbole_training: Source-query clicks before 2016-04-30, daily-session pseudousers, deduplicated exact events; no validation or confirmation labels
selection: Validation NDCG@10 for relevance models; validation lexical ILD maximum within 2% relative NDCG budget for reranking
confirmation_use: Evaluate frozen selected model/policy once; report paired session-cluster confidence intervals versus original model on same queries
limits: Same overall date period as prior inspected test, new supplied-session-disjoint outcome sample. Not an independent dataset or new temporal replication.
optional_view_features: Separate 48-feature models assume shared relative timeframe clocks for same sessionId/date. Use strict view time < query time; retain 40-feature no-view control. Added during validation development before confirmation.
validation_search: 12/40/48 features; 20k/60k query caps; LightGBM leaves 31/63; RecBole GRU4Rec BPR max15 epochs, early stop4; seven tree models plus original reference; gated score-fusion tree weights 0,.25,.5,.75,.9,.95,1
secondary_diversity_metric: Token cosine ILD@10 as a distance robustness check, while optimizing Jaccard ILD
